text:
elaine: Heads-up from compliance review this morning: the regulator flagged our Private offering for additional audit controls. They want KMS/HSM attestations + tamper-evident audit logs before any customer goes GA in that region. This is potentially blocking some early Private customers.
marcus: How blocking is it? Do they mean _before_ we can onboard pilot customers or before GA?
sophie: Compliance explicitly said pilot customers in regulated industries need attestations before onboarding — BetaBank and MediPilot fall into that. So it's blocking pilots unless we provide mitigations.
raj: Rough estimate from infra: KMS integration + HSM flow + audit-log immutability ~3 wks of focused work, plus another week for attestation paperwork and legal review. Could we ship with a documented mitigation and require customers to sign a temporary acceptance?
kevin: From product POV, options: 1) delay Private GA and keep Hosted/Dedicated timelines unchanged, 2) cut the Private GA scope to only VPC networking w/o attestation (so pilots can still run under a special contract), 3) offer a restricted pilot program with explicit risk acceptance.
elaine: We need to be pragmatic. Customers in regulated verticals can't accept risk without attestation. If we delay Private GA it's a 3-week slip to that milestone; that will ripple to sales cycles for those customers.
marcus: Can we decompose the Private deliverable? What are minimal features required for pilots vs GA?
sophie: Minimal for pilots: private VPC deployment, basic KMS wrapper (not yet attested), audit log retention, and ability to disable external integrations. For GA: HSM-backed key management, signed attestations, and immutable audit log service.
raj: My recommendation: split Private into "pilot-eligible" and "attested-GA" slices. Move the attestation pieces to v1.1, but only if legal/sales can secure pilot agreements for BetaBank and MediPilot. That avoids blocking other customers.
kevin: If we do that, we should also produce a short customer-facing decision memo explaining what pilots get vs what GA will include. CS needs it for negotiation.
marcus: Also, this impacts our milestone board. Proposal: shift Private GA milestone from 2026-06-14 -> 2026-07-05, mark pilot-eligible as 2026-06-14 (soft) with a gating task for attestation.
product-bot: Compliance sync scheduled: privacy-attestation huddle today 16:00 PT. Invite sent to @eng-security @legal @customer-success.
elaine: Draft cutlist proposal for v1 (lock if no objections by 15:30 PT):
- Keep for v1: Private VPC deploy, core API parity, model pinning, embeddings cache, basic audit logs (retention + export)
- Defer to v1.1: HSM-backed KMS attestation, signed compliance paperwork, tamper-evident append-only audit store
- Optional pilot add-ons: custom data residency controls, advanced retention policies
kevin: Fine by me as long as CS can secure pilot agreements and legal signs off on temporary mitigations.
sophie: I'll prepare the customer one-pager and a short FAQ for BetaBank and MediPilot outlining risk, timelines, and what we commit to deliver.
raj: Infra will prioritize KMS plumbing work in the sprint after next; I'll attach a detailed task list to the milestone card.
marcus: I'll update the milestone board and add the "pilot agreement" ticket for CS + Legal to chase. Link: https://confluence.redwood/private-attestation-plan
elaine: Please add objections here before 15:30. If none, we'll lock the cutlist and start CS outreach. :white_check_mark:
kevin: No blockers from product.
marcus: No infra objections; we'll prep a rollback plan in case pilots need to be paused.
sophie: :thumbsup: I'll post the one-pager draft by 17:00 for review.
product-bot: Decision recorded: private-ga delayed, pilot-eligible slice approved pending CS/legal signoffs.
